Template domains and fsaverage<->fsLR plans on worktree branch worktree-agent-a31ceb204dea3849c at 8dbfd593 plus 6763257b (not on main).
surface: TemplateMesh (fsaverage5/6/7, fsLR 32k/59k/164k; fsLR 59k is 59292 vertices, not 59412), TemplateSurface, TemplateSphere[R] (registration singleton type), TemplateResampling.plan, TemplateSphereAssets (18 pinned TemplateFlow spheres), JVM TemplateSphereFiles. Stock MNI grids: atlas TemplateGrids (2009c/6Asym res-01/02).
Parity vs Workbench 2.2.1 -metric-resample BARYCENTRIC (5 cases, 1002 seeded targets each): smooth fields up to 5.9e-7, seeded values up to 2.4e-5 (budgets 5e-5). fsaverage5/6 verified as nested prefixes of fsaverage.
Open: atlas SpaceTransforms fsaverage<->fsLR32k manifest steps remain map-less; graph domains are unsampled, so wiring TemplateResamplingPlan into SpatialGraph needs sampled surface domains (P7.07/P8). Asset-gated tests skip without a TemplateFlow cache.
